_doc: 42 fighter classes (O8). Each references 4 abilities in abilities.json and 2-3 presets in tactics-presets.json. Units: metres, seconds, decimal fractions.
status: DRAFT 2026-10-25 (combat designer). PROPOSED · TUNABLE values; spec docs/design/_drafts/03-combat.md.

classes.name: Oathguard
classes.flavor: Sworn to one paymaster at a time, and that paymaster never bleeds first.
classes.description: Bodyguard tank. Dashes to threatened allies, takes part of their damage, and bashes casters out of their spells.

classes.name: Gongbearer
classes.flavor: Carries a war-gong on its back; when it rings, every enemy forgets everyone else.
classes.description: Taunt tank. Rings its gong to force nearby enemies to attack it, then braces behind a shield and hardens while focused.

classes.name: Scarhide
classes.flavor: Every scar a contract paid; there is always room for one more.
classes.description: Regenerating bruiser. Heals constantly, cleaves crowds with lifesteal, and catches a second wind when it matters.

classes.name: Briarback
classes.flavor: Its armor grew barbs over years of bad clients; now everyone who swings at it pays.
classes.description: Thorns tank. Reflects damage back at melee attackers and scatters caltrops that slow and cut.

classes.name: Bladeturner
classes.flavor: Never blocks a blow it can step around, and never steps around one without answering.
classes.description: Evasive tank. Dodges weapon blows, counter-strikes from a parry stance and provokes single enemies. Spells go straight through.

classes.name: Phalanx Sergeant
classes.flavor: Drilled a hundred recruits to lock shields; now drills whoever its employer hires.
classes.description: Shield-wall tank. Shields the whole formation, pikes attackers back, and grows sturdier with allies beside it.

classes.name: Gutterknife
classes.flavor: Learned to fight where the lamplight didn't reach, and still prefers it there.
classes.description: Back-line diver. Shadowsteps behind distant targets, hamstrings them, and hits hardest when unseen.

classes.name: Bloodhowler
classes.flavor: Howls when wounded, and is always wounded.
classes.description: Berserker. Grows deadlier as it loses HP, frenzies for attack speed and lifesteal, and opens bleeding wounds.

classes.name: Twinfang
classes.flavor: Two blades, one rhythm; the longer the song, the faster it plays.
classes.description: Flurry duelist. Attack speed builds while it stays on one target; unleashes a channelled flurry and sidesteps danger.

classes.name: Headsman
classes.flavor: Paid by the head, and has never once been short-changed.
classes.description: Executioner. Slow, heavy chops; sunders armor and beheads wounded enemies, resetting the cooldown on a kill.

classes.name: Chaffcutter
classes.flavor: Built for crowds, paid by the head, never picky about which head.
classes.description: Cleaver. Leaps into clusters, spins a whirling harvest, and every swing splashes onto neighbours.

classes.name: Runecleaver
classes.flavor: Etched its blade with runes it only half understands, which is why it hits so hard.
classes.description: Arcane blade. Its weapon deals arcane damage that armor won't stop; bursts runes in a cone and lunges at casters to silence them.

classes.name: Longeye
classes.flavor: Never met a target it couldn't outwait.
classes.description: Sniper. Longest range in the league; aimed shots punish distant targets, and it leaps back when caught.

classes.name: Boltrunner
classes.flavor: Fires, runs, reloads, fires again; has never stood still long enough to be paid in person.
classes.description: Kiting crossbow. Moves fast and shoots quickly, pins chasers with a rooting bolt and tumbles away from melee.

classes.name: Emberwright
classes.flavor: Apprenticed to a forge, graduated to setting the whole arena alight.
classes.description: Pyromancer. Arcane fire: blooms of flame that burn groups and a lance that pierces a whole line.

classes.name: Blightbrewer
classes.flavor: Brews in the back of the wagon what other clubs pretend not to buy.
classes.description: Poisoner. Darts stack poison and spoil healing, flasks leave toxic clouds, and Rupture detonates the stacks.

classes.name: Thunderhand
classes.flavor: Struck by lightning twice, and took it as a career suggestion.
classes.description: Storm caster. Chain lightning arcs between enemies, and a thunderclap blasts back anyone who closes in.

classes.name: Writ Hunter
classes.flavor: Carries a satchel of signed warrants; one of them has your name on it.
classes.description: Bounty hunter. Posts a writ that makes one enemy take more damage from everyone, nets runners, and cashes in on marked kills.

classes.name: Rimebinder
classes.flavor: Grew up on a glacier and still thinks everyone else moves far too fast.
classes.description: Frost controller. Every bolt chills, a nova roots everyone nearby, and a glacial lance slows hard.

classes.name: Hexmonger
classes.flavor: Sells curses by the ounce and always throws in a free sample.
classes.description: Hexer. Withers the enemy's top damage dealer and curses groups to take extra damage; its debuffs linger.

classes.name: Galeshaper
classes.flavor: Talks to the wind, and the wind, unfortunately, listens.
classes.description: Wind controller. Blasts attackers away in a cone, drags enemies together with a downdraft, and speeds nearby allies.

classes.name: Hushweaver
classes.flavor: Knots silence into thread and sews it over other people's mouths.
classes.description: Anti-caster. Silences and interrupts, unravels enemy buffs and shields, and hits casters harder.

classes.name: Dreamthief
classes.flavor: Steals a few seconds of sleep from everyone it meets and sells them back at a markup.
classes.description: Sleep controller. Puts one enemy to sleep for a long time (enough damage wakes it) and dazes small groups.

classes.name: Snaresetter
classes.flavor: Has a trap for every kind of fool, and two for the fast ones.
classes.description: Trapper. Sets bear traps that root whoever steps on them and spills tar that slows; rooted prey takes extra damage.

classes.name: Chirurgeon
classes.flavor: Stitches faster than the opposition can cut, and charges by the stitch.
classes.description: Single-target healer. Big direct heals that grow on badly wounded allies, plus a tincture that cleanses.

classes.name: Cantor
classes.flavor: Sings the same hymn every fight; the crowd now sings it back.
classes.description: Area healer. Choruses that heal everyone nearby and a sanctuary that keeps healing; allies close to it regenerate.

classes.name: Aegis Scribe
classes.flavor: Writes warding sigils so quickly the ink is still wet when the blows land.
classes.description: Shield healer. Inscribes barriers on threatened allies before the damage lands, and lattices whole groups.

classes.name: Grovetender
classes.flavor: Talks to the arena moss between rounds; the moss, apparently, talks back.
classes.description: Heal-over-time healer. Keeps rejuvenation running on several allies at once and blooms when the group is hurt.

classes.name: Vigilkeeper
classes.flavor: Keeps a lantern lit for every fighter on its side, and refuses to let one go out.
classes.description: Death-denying healer. Wards an ally so a lethal blow leaves it standing, and catches allies who drop low.

classes.name: War Drummer
classes.flavor: Beats time for the whole line; the line has never once been out of step.
classes.description: Tempo healer. Drums that quicken allies' attacks and steps, and a rally beat that heals and frees allies from slows and roots.

classes.name: Siegebreaker
classes.flavor: Hired to knock down gates; finds people much easier.
classes.description: Battering bruiser. Its blows scale with its own max HP; charges into the back line and shrugs off punishment.

classes.name: Pavisier
classes.flavor: Carries a door-sized shield and a crossbow that needs a door-sized shield.
classes.description: Ranged bulwark. Plants its pavise to become an immovable, heavily armored turret, and shoves off anyone who gets close.

classes.name: Gaoler
classes.flavor: Has never lost a prisoner, and treats every opponent as one.
classes.description: Jailer tank. Shackles enemies in place, stomps to stun crowds, and slows everyone who stays near it.

classes.name: Harpooner
classes.flavor: Spent ten years hauling whales; the back line is lighter.
classes.description: Puller tank. Harpoons a distant enemy and reels it in, taunted; immune to being pushed around itself.

classes.name: Vowknight
classes.flavor: Swore a vow to bleed for others, and keeps it with alarming enthusiasm.
classes.description: Pain-sharing knight. Part of the damage it takes heals its weakest ally; it lays on hands and consecrates the ground.

classes.name: Deeproot Keeper
classes.flavor: Was a sapling when the Charter was signed, and is in no hurry.
classes.description: Rooted warden. Takes root to become a fortified healing totem, lashes nearby enemies with thorns, and regenerates.

classes.name: Netcaster
classes.flavor: Fights the old way: one net, one trident, no patience for runners.
classes.description: Net fighter. Nets enemies in place, lunges for heavy damage on rooted prey, and slows with every hit.

classes.name: Skullslinger
classes.flavor: Picks its stones for weight and its targets for thickness of skull.
classes.description: Concussive slinger. Stuns with a cracking shot, sprays slowing shot, and its stones weaken enemies.

classes.name: Leechblade
classes.flavor: Its sword drinks; it insists on sharing.
classes.description: Siphoning duelist. Every cut it lands heals its weakest ally; a crimson mist hurts enemies and mends friends.

classes.name: Sunlance Acolyte
classes.flavor: Sworn to a dawn-cult that takes its tithes in arena purses.
classes.description: Radiant striker. Brands enemies so that allies who hit them heal, and mends allies with dawn light.

classes.name: Undertow Mystic
classes.flavor: Reads the tides in the arena sand, and sometimes drowns people in them.
classes.description: Tide mystic. Floods an undertow that slows enemies and heals allies standing in it, and washes allies clean.

classes.name: Hourglass Sage
classes.flavor: Carries a cracked hourglass that runs a little differently for everyone near it.
classes.description: Time sage. Rewinds an ally's recent wounds, mires enemies in torpor, and speeds up nearby allies' cooldowns.
